formatVersion.description: The shape of this document. Bumped when a field changes meaning or leaves; adding a field does not bump it.

exportedAt.description: When the export was taken. The gift exchange it describes has moved on since.

hatId.description: The unique identifier of the gift exchange

name.description: The name of the gift exchange

status.description: The status of the gift exchange at the moment of export

additionalInformation.description: Additional details about the gift exchange

priceRange.description: The suggested price range for gifts

createdAt.description: When the gift exchange was created

invitationsQueuedAt.description: When invitations were queued for sending, or the minimum date when they have not been

copiedFromHatId.description: The gift exchange this one was copied from, or the all-zero uuid when it was not a copy

exchangeDate.description: The approximate day of the exchange, as yyyy-MM-dd, or 0001-01-01 when the organizer did not give one

organizer.description: The organizer of the gift exchange

participants.description: Everybody taking part, ordered by name

personId.description: The unique identifier of the person

email.description: The email address of the person

participantId.description: The unique identifier of this participant within this gift exchange

pickedRecipient.description: Who this participant drew. The empty reference until the picks are revealed, since the gift exchange keeps the draw from its own organizer until then.

emoji.description: The face this participant is marked with wherever they are named. One of a closed list the application offers.

eligibleRecipients.description: Who this participant was allowed to draw, ordered by name

deliveryStatus.description: How far the last email sent to this participant is known to have got: SENT, DELIVERED, DELAYED, BOUNCED, COMPLAINED, REJECTED or FAILED. Empty when nothing has been heard yet, which is not the same as not delivered.

deliveryDetail.description: Why, for the statuses that have a why: the bounce subtype and the receiving server's diagnostic. Empty otherwise. Written by a remote mail server, so it is neither moderated nor trusted.

deliveryMessageType.description: Which of this application's emails the status above is about: INVITATION, COMPLETION, PARTICIPANT_LEFT, ORGANIZER_LEFT_NOTE or UNSPECIFIED. Empty when nothing has been heard yet.

deliveryOccurredAt.description: When SES says the event behind the status happened, or the minimum date when nothing has been heard yet.

participantId.description: The participant being pointed at, or the all-zero uuid for nobody

name.description: The name that participant goes by, or empty for nobody
